## Produce the Final Quarto Report {#sec-text-project-final-report}

### Goal {#sec-text-project-final-report-goal}

Create a polished Quarto document presenting the results of the text analysis.

This working guide documents **how the analysis was completed**.

The final Quarto report communicates **what the analysis found**.

The final report may include:

- research question
- data sources
- methodology
- description of the articles
- text-processing methods
- text-analysis results
- visualizations
- interpretation
- limitations
- conclusions
